biological_question: Is the stronger observed conditional ancestry structure of early/regulatory and flavonol genes merely a consequence of unequal number of measured gene axes or of covariate residualization, rather than a biological trait of one flavonoid subnetwork?
observational_scope: One outcome-exposed Petunieae radiation; 47 taxa, 183 same-source exact fine biochemical presence matches; 21 gene axes. Module result already opened before this diagnostic was specified.

calculation.full_frame: exact same 47 taxa, 6 retained presence codes, same 183 unordered within-exact-code tip pairs
calculation.original_expression: same frozen 21 genes log1p(TPM10k), column population zscore across same 47 taxa
calculation.original_pigment_nuisance: same six pigment-code class dummies and all nine mg/g pigment covariates, source 47x47 M projection
calculation.module_residual_fraction: sum(residualized z scores squared)/sum(original standardized gene scores squared) within each of the 9/4/8 fixed modules; descriptive only
calculation.raw_vs_adjusted_module_rho: source phylogeny patristic rank vs per-module RMS of unadjusted standardized expression vectors, and of source pigmented-nuisance-residualized expression vectors, within fixed 183 pairs
calculation.fixed_four_gene_panels: enumerate all C(9,4)=126 late, C(8,4)=70 early+regulatory, and C(4,4)=1 flavonol; for each compute unadjusted/adjusted rho using original source, fixed 183 pair universe, no after-outcome selection or P value
calculation.fixed_eight_gene_panels: enumerate all C(9,8)=9 late 8-gene panels and the one full early+regulatory 8-gene panel, no flavonol group at size eight
calculation.summary: Panel rho min, median, max, 10th, 90th quantiles; descriptive cross-panel rank shares; same-gene-number comparisons are not independent biological samples, effect-difference tests, empirical P values, power estimates or confidence intervals
